title: Design System: What Are You Building

display.purpose: Masthead wordmark and featured-headline product name. The loudest type on the page.

headline.purpose: A product's name on its detail page.

body.purpose: Descriptions and prose, set in the serif. Cap measure at 65-75ch.

label.purpose: Vote counts, ranks, NEW/HOT nav, section tags, and controls. Never prose.

motion.name: ease-out-quint
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions (vote inversion, hover).

motion.name: duration-base
motion.purpose: Standard transition duration; keep state changes <=200ms.

components.name: Rule Button
components.description: Default control (+ SUBMIT, Google/GitHub sign-in). Flat paper, 2px ink rule, monospace label.
components.css: .ds-btn-rule { background: var(--paper, #f4f1ea); color: var(--ink, #111); border: 2px solid var(--ink, #111); border-radius: 0; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-rule:hover { background: var(--ink, #111); color: var(--paper, #f4f1ea); } .ds-btn-rule:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #111); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Vote Button
components.description: Tall ink-ruled upvote block: monospace caret + count. Add .is-voted for the inverted active state.
components.css: .ds-vote { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; background: var(--paper, #f4f1ea); color: var(--ink, #111); border: 2px solid var(--ink, #111); border-radius: 0; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-vote-caret { width: 0; height: 0; border-left: 6px solid transparent; border-right: 6px solid transparent; border-bottom: 9px solid currentColor; } .ds-vote:hover { background: #e9e4da; } .ds-vote.is-voted { background: var(--ink, #111); color: var(--paper, #f4f1ea); } .ds-vote:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #111); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Rule Input
components.description: Form field: paper fill, 2px ink rule, hard corners, serif text.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: var(--paper, #f4f1ea); color: var(--ink, #111); border: 2px solid var(--ink, #111); border-radius: 0; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; font-family: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #555); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink, #111); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ranked Row
components.description: One entry in the front-page index: rank (mono), thumbnail, name + tagline, vote count. Divided from siblings by a 1px hairline.

components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 0.625rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #ddd); text-decoration: none; color: var(--ink, #111); font-family: 'Fraunces', Georgia, serif; } .ds-row-rank { width: 1.5rem; text-align: right; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-row-thumb { width: 40px; height: 40px; background: var(--ink, #111); flex: none; } .ds-row-meta { flex: 1; } .ds-row-meta b { display: block; font-weight: 700; } .ds-row-meta span { display: block; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--muted, #555); } .ds-row-votes { border: 2px solid var(--ink, #111); padding: 0.2rem 0.5rem; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; }

narrative.overview: The interface is a printed broadsheet for people who ship: a bold serif masthead, a ranked front-page index of what's being built, entries separated by hairline rules. No color, no gradient, no shadow, no rounded corner — just ink pressed onto warm paper. The restraint is the statement: in a feed full of AI-generated SaaS pages, a black-and-white press page reads as taste, and taste is the first filter for the builders we want. The system is refined and restrained, carried by a single confident gesture: a 2px ink rule. Monospace is reserved for the broadsheet's machinery — counts, ranks, tags, nav — so metadata reads as type-set, never as prose.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome: warm paper + near-black ink, zero accent color.
No shadows; depth comes from 2px ink rules and 1px hairlines.
Serif (Fraunces) for everything readable; monospace (JetBrains Mono) only for counts, ranks, tags, and nav.
The ranked, hairline-ruled feed is the signature surface.

rules.name: The Monochrome Rule
rules.body: There is no color in this product. If a swatch has chroma, it does not belong. Emphasis is weight, scale, and ink/paper inversion — never hue.

rules.name: The Honest Gray Rule
rules.body: Caption Gray (#555555) is the floor for secondary text on Paper, never lighter. Light-gray-for-elegance is forbidden.

rules.name: The Mono-for-Machinery Rule
rules.body: Monospace appears only on counts, ranks, nav, tags, and metadata. Prose is always the serif.

rules.name: The Tight-Masthead Rule
rules.body: Display/headline weight is 800 with -0.5px tracking and text-wrap: balance. Never set the masthead below 800 or looser than -0.5px.

rules.name: The Flat Press Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow, no backdrop-filter, no glow — ever. If an element needs to stand apart, give it a rule or give it space.

dos: Do keep the system monochrome — warm Paper (#f4f1ea) and near-black Ink (#111). Emphasis via weight, scale, and ink/paper inversion.
Do use hard corners (radius 0) and a 2px ink rule as the one assertive gesture on any element.
Do reserve JetBrains Mono for counts, ranks, nav, tags, and metadata; set all prose in Fraunces.
Do keep secondary text at Caption Gray (#555) or darker — it holds ~6.7:1 on Paper.
Do convey depth with rules and spacing; keep every surface flat.
Do give every interactive control a visible focus state and a prefers-reduced-motion fallback.
Do treat the TODAY'S TOP / FEATURED tag as the one sanctioned tracked-uppercase label, used on the featured item only.
donts: Don't introduce the generic AI-SaaS look: no purple/indigo gradients, no glassy cards, no gradient text, no identical icon-card grids, no tracked-uppercase eyebrow above every section.
Don't drift toward a corporate dashboard: no sidebar + data-table + flat-gray enterprise chrome.
Don't reach for crypto/Web3 maximalism: no neon-on-black, no glows, no aggressive animation.
Don't add box-shadow, backdrop-filter, or blur — flat by doctrine.
Don't round corners. Radius is 0 everywhere.
Don't use a border-left/border-right color stripe as an accent — borders are full 2px ink rules or nothing.
Don't lighten secondary text past #555 for elegance.
Don't set prose in monospace or the masthead below 800 weight.
